name: gltf-model-clearcoat
adaptedFrom: original — two rough dark dielectric spheres loaded by three's GLTFLoader and the native glTF loader with KHR_materials_clearcoat: one coated by factors only (clearcoat 1, clearcoatRoughness 0.05), one with clearcoatTexture and clearcoatRoughnessTexture over factors 0.9 and 1.0 (fully rough where the map does not sharpen it). Each becomes a MeshPhysicalMaterial whose coat highlight the plain base lacks
